blocks.p: The Ghost of {hero:39} is Reforged Mode's post-Searing Ascalon hero, a Mesmer. She comes at the end of five Piken Square quests, {quest:101259} → {quest:101110} → {quest:101148} → {quest:101256} → {quest:101258}; the first two are the old Prophecies ones about Duke Barradin's daughter, the last three go into the Tunnels of the Forsaken, the post-Searing version of the pre-Searing tunnels, with a door in The Breach.

ul: {quest:101259} and {quest:101110} are plain Prophecies quests: any character, any mode. Since April 2026 any campaign's character can take them.
The three tunnel quests and the dungeon exist for Reforged characters only.
The gold is the Reforged bonus; XP and Althea are not.

blocks.note: Keep {quest:101258} in the log once {quest:101256} is done, or the tunnels fill with level 20 ghosts. Althea gives it where that one ends: take it in the same talk.

ol: Viggo, Piken Square.
Rezone from Grendich Courthouse or Nolani Academy until Althea's marker in Diessa Lowlands is close.
Run up and talk to her; the Charr around her don't matter.
Reward from Duke Barradin, Piken Square.
Barradin gives the quest and the Barradin Family Urn.
From Grendich Courthouse, north-east corner of Diessa Lowlands across the tar pit, into the Flame Temple Corridor.
Clear one path to the altar, or run in and click it with henchmen as the decoy.
Back to Barradin. Not with The Titan Source active.
Althea in The Breach; into the Tunnels of the Forsaken.
Full party, holy damage. Six from Yak's Bend is the easy version.
Clear the Spirits around a pyre, then stand in its ring until it lights: the bar moves by party members in range minus foes.
Heroes flee the ring: melee weapons or flag them inside, or one player holds the ring while the rest tank outside.
Three pyres, then Althea by the middle one.
Kopp the Quick, Piken Square.
Supplies to Althea on level 1.
North up the hill: the bandits drop an Elemental Keystone, carry it to the crystal gate. Level 2.
Keep left all the way to Duke Willgrove (the marker points at the exit). Talk with a free slot.
Map to Piken Square, walk back in: Althea is by the entrance.
Talk three times: supplies, reward, {quest:101258}. Then leave.
Only the bandits have to die: a runner does this.
Althea, level 1. Level 20 ghosts on level 1? Leave and re-enter.
Keystone from the bandits, gate, level 2, keep left; Althea walks with you.
Past where Willgrove stood she breaks a wall. Level 3.
Winding path, groups close together: pull.
Where it widens, south before the second shrine: the Enraged Phantom spawns on that group, Elementalist boss, Boss Key. Pull him off the ghosts.
East to the Boss Lock. Three waves of Manipulated Grawl: keep distance, recover between waves.
The God-touched Grawl (wave 2) turns friendly when low. Varny comes with wave 3, harmless alone: pull his Grawl off him first.
Chest, then Althea.

ul: Cover your important enchantments down there: the spirits strip them. Put cheap ones on top and watch them.
Varny's opening dialogue, and his Grawl, can be triggered from the ledge above by the Enraged Phantom.
On repeats the Grawl in the boss room can be pulled into the Echoes and Horsemen and thinned out before you face Varny; not on the first run, when those don't spawn yet.
Hard mode on a repeat gives two max gold inscribable weapons from the chest; the quest reward is unchanged (500 XP).

Spare urns: storage one, Barradin gives another; each urn clicks the altar once more for another set of ashes. The ashes can also be bought from a player. Nothing comes from the altar without the quest active.
